name: Español

lexemes.caution: «escalera» is a ladder and a staircase.
«el cajón» is also a big crate — context decides.
«la foto» stays feminine — short for «la fotografía».
Feminine — «el» only in the singular: «las anclas».
«carta» is a letter — also a menu and a playing card.
«el globo» alone means "balloon" — this one carries the world.
«el pescado» is fish on a plate; a live fish is «el pez».
A wrench is a «llave inglesa» — an "English key."

lexemes.phrase: mide el frío y el calor
dice de quién es la maleta

lexemes.caution: «las esposas» also means "wives." The police joke writes itself.
